title: Black Clover
synopsis:
Asta and Yuno were abandoned at the same church on the same day. Raised together as children, they came to know of the "Wizard King"—a title given to the strongest mage in the kingdom—and promised that they would compete against each other for the position of the next Wizard King. However, as they grew up, the stark difference between them became evident. While Yuno is able to wield magic with amazing power and control, Asta cannot use magic at all and desperately tries to awaken his powers by training physically.

When they reach the age of 15, Yuno is bestowed a spectacular Grimoire with a four-leaf clover, while Asta receives nothing. However, soon after, Yuno is attacked by a person named Revchi, whose main purpose is to obtain Yuno's Grimoire. Asta tries to fight Revchi, but he is outmatched. Though without hope and on the brink of defeat, he finds the strength to continue when he hears Yuno's voice. Unleashing his inner emotions in a rage, Asta receives a five-leaf clover Grimoire, a "Black Clover" giving him enough power to defeat Revchi. A few days later, the two friends head out into the world, both seeking the same goal—to become the Wizard King!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Asta y Yuno fueron abandonados en la misma iglesia el mismo día. Criados juntos desde niños, conocieron al "Rey Mago", un título otorgado al mago más fuerte del reino, y prometieron que competirían entre sí por el puesto del próximo Rey Mago. Sin embargo, a medida que crecieron, la marcada diferencia entre ellos se hizo evidente. Si bien Yuno es capaz de ejercer magia con un poder y control asombrosos, Asta no puede usar magia en absoluto y trata desesperadamente de despertar sus poderes entrenando físicamente.

Cuando cumplen 15 años, Yuno recibe un espectacular Grimorio con un trébol de cuatro hojas, mientras que Asta no recibe nada. Sin embargo, poco después, Yuno es atacado por una persona llamada Revchi, cuyo objetivo principal es obtener el Grimorio de Yuno. Asta intenta luchar contra Revchi, pero es superado. Aunque sin esperanza y al borde de la derrota, encuentra la fuerza para continuar cuando escucha la voz de Yuno. Al desatar sus emociones internas con rabia, Asta recibe un Grimorio de trébol de cinco hojas, un "Trébol Negro" que le da suficiente poder para derrotar a Revchi. Unos días más tarde, los dos amigos salen al mundo, ambos buscando el mismo objetivo: ¡convertirse en el Rey Mago!

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]
background: Black Clover adapts the first 27 volumes of the original manga.
